resolution.note: Added deterministic test: expired claim plus held lock must yield exit 75 with the claim file untouched; fails 5/5 with the lock removed, passes 10/10 on head. The old 12-process race test passed 6/6 even with the lock removed (kept as integration stress).

title: Test the claim race deterministically
body:
The claim race test in `test/task/claim-lock.test.ts:23-86` passes on the pre-lock base (4/4 runs, `.krn/runs/independent-review-followup/report.md` N1), so it does not guard the double-winner race fixed in #110. Add a deterministic interleaving test: patch the rename seam (e.g. `syncBuiltinESMExports`) or an inspect hook so the expired-claim race is forced without timing; pattern in `.krn/runs/independent-review-followup/artifacts/b1-deterministic-base.mjs`.
Acceptance: the test fails on 06126f7 every run and passes on the head, with no sleeps or timing assertions.
